onboarding.title: Welcome to GuideTrain
onboarding.subtitle: A few quick details so we can tailor your training.

explorer.greeting: Hi {name} — rotate the model, filter by region, and tap a muscle.
explorer.greetingAnon: Rotate the model, filter by region, and tap a muscle.

viewer.pairWhy: Different regions, so neither tires the other.

abs.name: Rectus Abdominis
abs.desc: The 'six-pack'; flexes the spine, resists extension. Crunches, leg raises, planks.

add.name: Adductors
add.desc: Inner thigh; pulls the legs together, stabilises hips. Adduction, sumo squats.

bic.name: Biceps Brachii
bic.desc: Front of the upper arm; bends the elbow, supinates the forearm. Curls.

calf.name: Gastrocnemius / Calf
calf.desc: Two-headed calf bulge; points the toes (plantarflexion). Standing calf raises.

delt.name: Deltoid
delt.desc: Shoulder cap in three heads; raises the arm every direction. Presses, lateral raises.

erector.name: Erector Spinae
erector.desc: Columns beside the spine; extends and stabilises the back. Deadlifts, back extensions.

fore.name: Forearm
fore.desc: Grip, wrist and finger drivers. Wrist curls, grip work, carries.

glute.name: Gluteus Maximus
glute.desc: Largest muscle; extends the hip, drives power. Squats, hip thrusts, bridges.

ham.name: Hamstrings
ham.desc: Back-thigh group; bends the knee, extends the hip. RDLs, leg curls, deadlifts.

lat.name: Latissimus Dorsi
lat.desc: The 'wings' of the back; pulls the arms down and back. Pull-ups, rows, pulldowns.

neck.name: Neck
neck.desc: Sternocleidomastoid and neck extensors; turns and steadies the head. Neck curls, shrugs, harness work.

obl.name: External Oblique
obl.desc: Flanks of the abdomen; rotates and side-bends the trunk. Twists, side planks.

pec.name: Pectoralis Major
pec.desc: Chest fan; pushes and draws the arm across the body. Bench press, flyes, push-ups.

quad.name: Quadriceps
quad.desc: Front-thigh group of four; straightens the knee. Squats, lunges, leg extensions.

shin.name: Tibialis Anterior
shin.desc: Front of the shin; lifts the foot (dorsiflexion). Toe raises, walks.

traps.name: Trapezius
traps.desc: Upper back & neck yoke; shrugs and stabilises the shoulder blades. Shrugs, face-pulls.

tri.name: Triceps Brachii
tri.desc: Back of the upper arm; straightens the elbow. Dips, pushdowns, overhead extensions.
